Title: Valid Login
Description: Verify user can login with correct credentials
Test Steps: Enter username "tomsmith" and password "SuperSecretPassword!" -> Click login

Title: Invalid Username
Description: Verify error message for incorrect username
Test Steps: Enter username "wronguser" and password "SuperSecretPassword!" -> Click login
Expected Result: Error message "Your username is invalid!" displayed

Title: Invalid Password
Description: Verify error message for incorrect password
Test Steps: Enter username "tomsmith" and password "wrongpass" -> Click login
Expected Result: Error message "Your password is invalid!" displayed

Title: Empty Username
Description: Verify error when username is empty
Test Steps: Leave username empty and enter password "SuperSecretPassword!" -> Click login
Expected Result: Error message "Your username is invalid!" displayed

Title: Empty Password
Description: Verify error when password is empty
Test Steps: Enter username "tomsmith" and leave password empty -> Click login
Expected Result: Error message "Your username is invalid!" displayed

Title: Both Empty
Description: Verify error when both fields empty
Test Steps: Leave username and password empty -> Click login
Expected Result: Error message "Your username is invalid!" displayed

Title: Leading/Trailing Spaces in Username
Description: Verify spaces should not be trimmed
Test Steps: Enter username "  tomsmith  " and correct password -> Click login

Title: Leading/Trailing Spaces in Password
Description: Verify spaces should not be trimmed
Test Steps: Enter username "tomsmith" and password "  SuperSecretPassword!  " -> Click login

Title: Case Sensitivity Username
Test Steps: Enter username "TomSmith" and correct password -> Click login

Title: Case Sensitivity Password
